items.source: This implementation does not use Cleaner.Cleanable so care must be taken to release ZipContent resources. The close() method should be called explicitly or by try-with-resources. Care must be take to only call close once.
items.translation: 此实现未使用Cleaner.Cleanable，因此必须小心释放ZipContent资源。应显式调用close()方法或通过 try-with-resources 调用。务必确保仅调用一次 close 方法。

items.source: ZipContent for a typical Spring Boot application JAR will have somewhere in the region of 10,500 entries which should consume about 122K.
items.translation: ZipContent 对于典型的 Spring Boot 应用程序 JAR，将包含大约 10,500 个条目，占用约 122K。

items.source: ZipContent results are cached and it is assumed that zip content will not change once loaded. Entries and Strings are not cached and will be recreated on each access which may produce a lot of garbage.
items.translation: ZipContent 的结果会被缓存，并且假定 zip 内容在加载后不会改变。条目和字符串不会被缓存，每次访问时都会重新创建，这可能会产生大量垃圾对象。

items.source: To release resources, the close() method of the data block should be called explicitly or by try-with-resources.
items.translation: 为释放资源，应显式调用数据块的close()方法，或使用 try-with-resources 语句。

items.source: The returned data block should not be accessed once close() has been called.
items.translation: 返回的数据块在调用close()后不应再被访问。

items.source: In order to reduce memory consumption, this implementation stores only the hash of the entry names, the central directory offsets and the original positions. Entries are stored internally in hashCode order so that a binary search can be used to quickly find an entry by name or determine if the zip file doesn't have a given entry.
items.translation: 为了减少内存消耗，此实现仅存储条目名称的哈希值、中央目录偏移量和原始位置。条目在内部按 hashCode 顺序存储，以便使用二分查找快速通过名称查找条目或确定 zip 文件是否包含给定条目。

items.translation: 对于嵌套目录的 zip 文件，将创建一个仅包含相关内容的虚拟数据块。
